thread.title_full: Frank Lavore running for Tioga County Sheriff - NewsBreak

author: Jim Ehmke
title: Frank Lavore running for Tioga County Sheriff - NewsBreak
text:
By Jim Ehmke ,
6 hours ago
TIOGA COUNTY, N.Y. (WIVT/WBGH) – Tioga County Sheriff Gary Howard has made it official telling News 34 that he does not plan to run for re-election next year.
Two men are already gearing up to replace him.
Frank Lavore of Berkshire is seeking the Republican nomination.
Lavore had a 25-year career at the Tioga County Sheriff’s Office.
The Spencer-Van Etten graduate began as a corrections officer in 1997, joined the road patrol in 2001 and became a road patrol sergeant in 2013.
He retired from that position in 2022.
Lavore says his main concern regarding the Sheriff’s Department is staffing.
He says unfilled positions are putting a major strain on road patrol deputies and C-O’s, with many working double shifts and lacking proper backup.
Lavore says the labor shortages not only impact response times but also endanger officer safety and their mental wellbeing.
“They’re overworked. Yesterday, six 9-1-1 calls were holding. A lot of times, this county is 523 square miles, and in the past few years, without the proper staffing, there’s times when you have 2 cars patrolling this whole county,” Lavore said.
Lavore says he’d also like to see more corrections officers receive firearms training so that they can conduct inmate transfers to alleviate some of the burden from deputies.
Lavore says that throughout his career, he had excellent rapport with his fellow officers and enjoyed mentoring the newer ones.
He says he retired in part over frustration with the state’s bail reform laws, but very quickly realized how much he missed it.
He believes he’s the right person to guide the department into the future.
“Because I have good intentions. I am a genuine person, genuinely care about the Sheriff’s Office, this community. I want to do something; I don’t want to be something,” Lavore said.
Lavore is currently working part-time for the Owego Police Department.
Former Captain of Operations at the Tioga Sheriff’s Office Shawn Nalepa is also running for the position.
